_note: minScore is the legacy fallback; use categoryMinScore for per-category thresholds
_cycleNote: Watcher cron interval and startup jitter. hostBackoffCycles = how many 10-min cycles to skip a host after 429/503/challenge.
_appNote: Study app (APP_URL + APP_TOKEN in .env). appQueueEnabled: POST every instant match to /api/applications. appDigestCron: when to send 'У черзі N готових заявок' (machine-local time, empty string = off).
_signalWeightsNote: Keys = exact strings in signals.languages / signals.llm / signals.aiTooling / signals.frontend. Java/.NET/PHP negatives live here because the scraper already detects them in signals.languages.
_textWeightsNote: Regex patterns against title+description. Only for terms not covered by signals.
_foreignStacksNote: Stack names enabled for the foreign-stack filter. Regexes are defined in watch-filter.ts. Python is intentionally absent (it is part of own-stack).
_gateNote: remoteOnly: block everything not explicitly remote (hybrid, office, unknown). maxRequiredYears: block vacancies that ask for more years than this (null = off). Both need no code change, flip here and restart JobWatcher.
